summary:
The iPhone 11 Pro was Apple's first triple-camera iPhone. Six years on, most are due some attention.

The faults we see most on this model are degraded batteries, OLED burn-in from heavy use, a worn Lightning port and telephoto camera failures. We repair all of them at our workshop in Silvercrest Shopping Centre, Silvamonte, including Face ID faults that many shops won't touch.

Every repair starts with a free diagnostic, so you get a clear answer and price before any work begins. Repairs carry a 6-month warranty, and we collect and deliver anywhere in Gauteng for a flat R300.

Tap Learn more for the full iPhone 11 Pro price list.
